title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Role & Responsibilities Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic interviews. Understand client requirements and identify suitable candidates. Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and clients. Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Maintain daily call reports, candidate details, and recruitment trackers. Achieve daily and monthly recruitment targets. Ensure regular follow-ups to improve interview attendance and joining ratios. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Any graduate with good communication skills. Freshers are welcome to apply. Final-year students and recent graduates can also apply. Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Basic knowledge of MS Excel and computer operations. Willingness to learn recruitment processes and work towards targets. Positive attitude, confidence, and good follow-up skills. Candidates from Trichy and nearby locations are preferred. Immediate joiners are preferred.

Key Skills: Talent acquisition,Acquisition,Sourcing
